findings.evidence: Pullback.lean defines `baseSet := fun x => f ⁻¹' A.core.baseSet (f x)` (line 58) and has only `localTriv_baseSet_pullback` and `coordChange_pullback` as unfolding lemmas; grep finds no `baseSet_pullback` or `mem_baseSet_pullback` lemma.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem baseSet_pullback (A) (f) (i) : (A.pullback f).core.baseSet i = f ⁻¹' A.core.baseSet (f i) := (rfl)` (or a `mem_baseSet_pullback` iff) to Pullback.lean, and rewrite with it at all four sites in place of the unfolding and the `change`.
findings.issue: Membership in `(C.pullback f).core.baseSet i` is silently unfolded to `f x ∈ C.core.baseSet (f i)` at four sites: `pullbackChartAverage` `compatible` (passing `hi`/`hi'` to `coordChange_comp_chartAverage`), `pullbackChartAverage` `operator` (domRestrict of `continuousOn_chartAverage` on a definitionally equal set), `contMDiffOn_inChartCoordinates_pullbackChartAverage` (passing `hx.1` to `contMDiffAt_chartAverage`), and `change f x ∈ C.core.baseSet (f a)` in `exists_isOpen_isInvertible_fiberMap_pullbackChartAverage`, whose comment explains the maths, not the `change`.

findings.evidence: `operator_pullbackChartAverage ... : (pullbackChartAverage C f χ hχ).operator i j x = chartAverage C f χ (f i) j x.val := (rfl)` is declared in the same file.
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with `rw [operator_pullbackChartAverage, hfs a ha]` (then close with `exact hinv` or similar).
findings.issue: In `exists_isOpen_isInvertible_fiberMap_pullbackChartAverage`, `change (chartAverage C f χ (f a) a x).IsInvertible` unfolds the definition of `pullbackChartAverage`'s operator even though this PR adds `operator_pullbackChartAverage` for exactly that.

summary: Proofs are short and readable, but several steps rely on undocumented definitional unfolding of the pullback's chart domains and of `pullbackChartAverage`'s operator, including two `change` tactics. Both can be replaced by an explicit `rfl` lemma or by the existing `operator_pullbackChartAverage`.
